note: A subject member — the listed identity is the proven caller, and a field naming one would be a field an attacker can set.
Unknown top-level member is rejected (additionalProperties: false).
Response without `signingKeys` — an identity with no keys is answered with an empty array, never an absent member.
A listed key that is not a did:key.
A listed delegation without expiresAt — every delegation has one, and a holder deciding what to revoke needs to see it.
